eclass/arc-build: Remove dead code Remove implementation of arc-build-select-clang() and exported arc-build_src_prepare(). The former has never been used to build any package and is unlikely to work. It will be revisited when adding Clang support properly (b/65189615). The latter has never been used in any ebuild and it is actually incorrect, since the proper place to call arc-build-select-gcc() is src_configure(). Moreover, its usability is really low, since an ebuild typically needs to do much more in src_configure() stage than just calling arc-build initialization. BUG=b:65227053 TEST=none (removing unused code) Change-Id: Id6dbf49a001d8b2dbfb40af1302ac732a7427bb2 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/641080 Commit-Ready: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org> Tested-by: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org>

eclass/arc-build: Unify chromeos-base/arc-build* The explicit Android version USE flag checks in arc-build eclass are only needed now for selecting proper dependency (arc-build vs arc-build-nyc). However we want to move version-specific defines to profiles of particular versions. Since all the chromeos-base/arc-build* packages differ only by ARC_BASE path (defined by profile already) and .pc files inside ${FILESDIR}, we can merge them into one package that has .pc files for all versions under subdirectories of ${FILESDIR} and installs the right ones based on the android-container-* USE flags. While at it, put the new ebuild under sys-devel/ category where we already have other build-related packages. BUG=b:65227053 TEST=emerge-elm arc-img-ddk CQ-DEPEND=CL:*443034 Change-Id: I0c7b29981f54a38d94ac9d38c91ea881f13014b0 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/641082 Commit-Ready: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org> Tested-by: Tomasz Figa <tfiga@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Ben Chan <benchan@chromium.org>

pack_firmware: Show the model name in the versions file At present for shared firmware we list all the firmware versions but there is no indication of which model they are for. Previously this was obvious since it was part of the version name: BIOS version: Google_Reef.9042.50.0 With shared firmware, we can have a situation where all models use the same firmware and thus have the same line above. Add a new line which shows the model, so we have, for example: Model: reef BIOS image: 99a6fc64e45596aa2c1a9911cddce952 */models/reef/image.bin BIOS version: Google_Reef.9042.50.0 EC image: 60c08e5aefa3a660687c7027d1358df0 */models/reef/ec.bin EC version: reef_v1.1.5857-77f6ed7 Model: pyro BIOS image: 409974485838ed7beb199b42892ba948 */models/pyro/image.bin BIOS version: Google_Pyro.9042.41.0 EC image: 752de0224d5b3bae77d12534d3df8038 */models/pyro/ec.bin EC version: pyro_v1.1.5840-f0d7761 Model: electro BIOS image: 99a6fc64e45596aa2c1a9911cddce952 */models/reef/image.bin BIOS version: Google_Reef.9042.50.0 EC image: 60c08e5aefa3a660687c7027d1358df0 */models/reef/ec.bin EC version: reef_v1.1.5857-77f6ed7 Here, electro uses the reef firmware, but it is obvious that this is the case.
